notes.title: GAME REVAMP UPDATE
notes.notes:
Revamped game dialogue to better fit the storyline!
Also made the option to lower sensitivity even more due to review feedback  ːsteammockingː

Specifics:
Lowered "Potassium Conundrum" passing score from 244 to 150
Removed lovey-dovey side story since it fit very poorly with the game (and awkwardly so!)
*Replaced it with a helpful outsider sidekick bro dialogue! ːsteamhappyː
Better dialogue queues for helping the player progress and understand what's happening

notes.title: Squeaky Clean Update
notes.notes:
Removed unintentional breathing sounds on FRED boss
Fixed FRED boss skipping exploit
Put a bigger than normal banana in the map somewhere 
Fixed a bug where the cursor would hide in the menu
Fixed 'ghost firing' on guns (mainly flare) when your clip is empty

notes.title: Tutorial Update
notes.notes: Tells the player how to use sprint, weapon swap, etc now at the start!

notes.title: Vent Patch
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where crawling through the vent didn't load the next level correctly
